sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
d=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
# parse btree header at 0
typ=d[0]; free=struct.unpack('>H',d[1:3])[0]; n=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]; cstart=struct.unpack('>H',d[5:7])[0]; frag=d[7]
print('type',hex(typ),'free',free,'n',n,'cstart',hex(cstart),'frag',frag)
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(n)]
print('ptrs',[hex(p) for p in ptrs])

def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|b
            return v,pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not b&0x80:
            return v,pos+i+1
    return v,pos+9

def serial_len(t):
    if t==0: return 0
    if t==1: return 1
    if t==2: return 2
    if t==3: return 3
    if t==4: return 4
    if t==5: return 6
    if t==6: return 8
    if t==7: return 8
    if t in (8,9): return 0
    if t==10 or t==11: return 0
    if t%2==0: return (t-12)//2
    return (t-13)//2

def decode_int(b):
    return int.from_bytes(b,'big',signed=True)

for p in ptrs:
    print('\nptr',hex(p),'bytes',d[p:p+28].hex(' '))
    plen,q=varint(d,p)
    rowid,q2=varint(d,q)
    payload=d[q2:q2+plen]
    print(' plen',plen,'rowid',rowid,'payload',payload.hex(' '))
    hs,hp=varint(payload,0)
    print(' header size',hs)
    serials=[]
    pp=hp
    while pp<hs:
        t,pp=varint(payload,pp)
        serials.append(t)
    print(' serials',serials)
    body=hs
    vals=[]
    for t in serials:
        L=serial_len(t)
        raw=payload[body:body+L]
        body+=L
        if t==0: val=None
        elif t==1: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==2: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==3: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==4: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==5: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==6: val=decode_int(raw)
        elif t==7: val=struct.unpack('>d',raw)[0]
        elif t==8: val=0
        elif t==9: val=1
        elif t>=13 and t%2==1: val=raw.decode('utf-8','replace')
        else: val=raw
        vals.append(val)
    print(' vals',vals, 'consumed',body,'of',plen)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || echo "no /app"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,struct
d=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
n=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(n)]
def varint(buf,pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8: return (v<<8)|b,pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not b&0x80: return v,pos+i+1
def slen(t):
    return [0,1,2,3,4,6,8,8,0,0,0,0][t] if t<12 else ((t-12)//2 if t%2==0 else (t-13)//2)
out=[]
for p in ptrs:
    plen,q=varint(d,p); rowid,q=varint(d,q)
    payload=d[q:q+plen]
    hs,hp=varint(payload,0)
    serials=[]; pp=hp
    while pp<hs:
        t,pp=varint(payload,pp); serials.append(t)
    body=hs; vals=[]
    for t in serials:
        L=slen(t); raw=payload[body:body+L]; body+=L
        if t==0: v=None
        elif 1<=t<=6: v=int.from_bytes(raw,'big',signed=True)
        elif t==7: v=struct.unpack('>d',raw)[0]
        elif t==8: v=0
        elif t==9: v=1
        elif t>=13 and t%2: v=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        else: v=raw.hex()
        vals.append(v)
    out.append({'word':vals[1],'value':vals[2]})
out.sort(key=lambda x:x['word'])
open('recover.json','w').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out))
PY
cat recover.json
EOF
